scenes.title: Measure the ordered source atoms
scenes.caption: Enter atom numbers in order for the distance, angle, and signed torsion. The middle atom is the angle vertex.

scenes.title: Export the figure and measurement table
scenes.caption: Save the annotated PNG with the visible bond monitor. Export a CSV that retains all three measurement definitions.

scenes.title: Ask the connector to measure
scenes.caption: Ask for the three ordered measurements, including their units and statuses. The GUI and connector number atoms differently.
scenes.prompt: Measure 1–2, 1–2–7, and 1–2–7–3 using the displayed atom numbers. Identify the matching source indices.

scenes.title: Verify the label and CSV
scenes.caption: The C1–C2 distance is 1.525 angstroms. The CSV keeps the angle and negative signed torsion even when their monitors are hidden.
scenes.prompt: Export the annotated view and a measurement CSV. Read the file back and verify all three ordered definitions.
